desc: The Barstow is a folding dagger and everything about this slim, sleek blade is simple, direct and ready. The straight spear-point blade, sharpened on a single side, is made of 8Cr13MoV stainless steel with Kershaw's black oxide BlackWash coating for a non-reflective, "already broken in" look. The handle has glass-filled nylon scales with heavy arrow-patterned texturing to enhance grip. A stout steel liner, also with non-reflective BlackWash, provides an equally stout liner lock to secure the blade open during use. The Barstow opens quickly and easily with SpeedSafe assisted opening and the built-in flipper. All the hardware is black with the notable exception of the Barstow's tube spacers, which are anodized in blue for a touch of subtle color and eye-catching interest. For convenient and discreet carry, the deep-carry pocket clip enables the knife to ride low in the pocket and is left/right reversible.
